battle.name: 羅斯-拜占庭戰爭 (941年)
battle.theater: 黑海北岸至多瑙河下游
battle.brief: 公元941年，基輔羅斯王公伊戈爾大舉進攻拜占庭：五百艘戰船沿第聶伯河出海，逼近博斯普魯斯海峽，陸上騎兵縱隊掃過多瑙河下游。皇帝狄奧斐洛斯自安條克星夜回師，封鎖海峽、備妥希臘火。秋日黑海風暴摧毀雙方船隊，遠征失敗。卡面的埃及長矛指向的正是拜占庭以矛列陣的軍區民兵傳統。

kit.name: 埃及長矛
kit.history: 早王朝時期的長矛，銅或青銅矛頭綁在木杆上。埃及人用它守城垣，後來也用它收復失地。

countries: 這場戰爭是公元941年東歐與地中海世界的一次正面交鋒：一方是基輔與諾夫哥羅德兩處羅斯公國勢力組織起來的東歐軍事聯盟，另一方是拜占庭帝國。羅斯一方由伊戈爾·羅斯洛維奇領銜，他當時是諾夫哥羅德的統治者，出征得到其父奧列格的允許與本部兵源的支援。聯軍骨幹並非單一族裔，而是瓦良格人（北歐維京裔）、東斯拉夫人與斯堪的納維亞水手拼成的混合戰鬥團體，沿第聶伯河以人力拉纜「拉舟」而下，於黑海以北的碼頭轉為海運。海軍方面，編年史所記船隊約五百艘，船上載步行戰士、弓箭手與矛兵，也裝載攻城木料、繩索與淡水；陸上則是一支規模極大的騎兵縱隊，攜帶大量馬匹，由伊戈爾本人率領，經東歐草原與保加爾人的地界，進抵多瑙河下游與色雷斯。拜占庭一方由皇帝狄奧斐洛斯坐鎮君士坦丁堡，核心是首都禁衛軍（歐根、禁衛近衛、學士騎士團）與首都軍區的常備兵，以及從安納托利亞、色雷斯、亞美尼亞、克里米亞與埃及各軍區抽調的民兵與徵召兵；外籍傭兵中，瓦良格人衛兵是皇帝近衛中最受信任的一支。海軍方面，黑海與馬爾馬拉海的分艦隊奉命封鎖博斯普魯斯海峽，帝國還以黃金津貼僱用佩切涅格人、馬扎爾人等草原部眾，在羅斯腹地製造牽制，以多瑙河防軍與色雷斯駐軍擋住陸路。皇帝同時被南方的阿拔斯王朝牽制在安條克與小亞美尼亞方向，西部戰線無法集中全部兵力。
countriesEn: This war was a direct collision between eastern Europe and the Mediterranean world in the year 941. On one side stood the military coalition raised by the Rus' principalities of Kyiv and Novgorod; on the other stood the Byzantine Empire. The Rus' force was led by Igor Roslavich, then ruler of Novgorod, with the consent of his father Oleg and with the manpower of his own land. The backbone of the coalition was not a single people but a mixed body of warriors drawn from the Varangians, that is Northmen of Scandinavian origin, together with East Slavs and Scandinavian sailors. They hauled their boats down the Dnieper and shifted to sea transport at the landing places north of the Black Sea. The naval arm is given in the chronicles as a fleet of about five hundred ships, carrying infantry, archers and spear-men, together with timber, rope and fresh water for siege work. The land arm was an enormous column of cavalry with a large number of horses, commanded in person by Igor, which moved through the eastern steppe and the territory of the Bulgars towards the lower Danube and Thrace. The Byzantine side was centred on the emperor Theophilos at Constantinople, with the capital guard, the tagmata of the Excubitores, the Scholai and the Hetaireia, and the troops of the Opsikion as its core, together with levies and conscripts drawn from the themes of Anatolia, Thrace, Armenia, the Crimea and Egypt. Among the foreign mercenaries the Varangian Guard was the most trusted body of the emperor's personal troops. At sea, the squadrons assigned to the Black Sea and the Sea of Marmara were ordered to seal the Bosporus, and the empire also paid gold subsidies to Pecheneg and Magyar bands so that they would operate against the Rus' hinterland, while the Danube frontier troops and the garrison of Thrace were to block the land route. The emperor was at the same time pinned down in the south by the Abbasid caliphate in the direction of Antioch and Little Asia, and could not concentrate the whole of his strength on the western front.
people: 伊戈爾·羅斯洛維奇是這場遠征的實際統帥。他出身羅斯王公家族，譜系被追述到瓦良格人首領瓦爾基的三兄弟，父親奧列格是基輔與諾夫哥羅德的奠基者，也是最早代表羅斯向拜占庭朝貢並受洗的統治者之一。《羅斯編年史》（Primary Chronicle）把這次遠征記在 6411 年，並保留了「父親允許其出征」的說法；《斯克里齊斯編年史續編》則把奧列格之死定在 922 年，兩者年代互相矛盾，這是羅斯早期編年傳統常見的漏洞，也說明 941 年事件的細節多靠二手記載拼湊。拜占庭方面，總指揮是皇帝狄奧斐洛斯（829 至 942 年在位），其兄君士坦丁七世自 913 年起以共治皇帝的身分居於宮中；狄奧斐洛斯自 839 年起在東方與阿拔斯王朝長期消耗，941 年又因奇利乞亞的失利而聲望受損，遠征的消息迫使他放棄前線星夜西歸。皇帝身邊另有掌艦隊的「海軍大旗官」（droungarios tou ploimou）與內廷禁軍的統帥，負責海峽封鎖與首都防務。羅斯方面的另一位重要人物是伊戈爾之妻奧莉加，她後來在君士坦丁堡受洗並取名格列高利；其子斯維亞托斯拉夫此時尚是少年，卻在父親戰敗後的動盪中迅速長成，並在十年後成為拜占庭最難纏的對手。另有記載把波蘭的梅什科一世在 941 至 942 年間遣使基輔與君士坦丁堡求援一事，與這次羅斯遠征相連，雖然年代仍有爭議。
peopleEn: Igor Roslavich was the actual commander of the expedition. He came from the Rus' princely house whose genealogy was traced back to the three brothers led by the Varangian chief Vorko, and his father Oleg was the founder of Kyiv and Novgorod and one of the first rulers to send an embassy to Constantinople and to be baptised there. The Primary Chronicle records the expedition under the year 6411 and preserves the tradition that the father gave his son leave to go, while the Continuation of the Chronicle of Skylitzes places Oleg's death in 922; the two chronologies contradict each other. That contradiction is a standard flaw of the early Rus' annalistic tradition, and it means that the details of 941 survive only in second-hand sources. On the Byzantine side the command was the emperor's: Theophilos, who reigned from 829 to 942, with his brother Constantine VII holding the position of co-emperor in the palace from 913 onwards. Theophilos had been worn down by a long war against the Abbasid caliphate in the east since 839 and had suffered a reverse in Cilicia in 941, and the news of the Rus' invasion forced him to abandon the front and travel back west by the fastest roads. Around him were the naval commander who held the office of droungarios tou ploimou, the flag-officer of the fleet, and the officials in charge of the palace guard, responsible for sealing the straits and for the defence of the capital. On the Rus' side another important figure was Igor's wife Olga, who was later baptised in Constantinople and took the name Helena. Their son Sviatoslav was still a boy in 941 but grew up quickly in the disorder that followed his father's defeat, and within ten years he had become the most persistent opponent Byzantium faced. There are also accounts that connect the Polish ruler Mieszko I, said to have sent embassies to Kyiv and to Constantinople in 941 or 942 to ask for help, with this Rus' campaign, though the dating of those embassies remains disputed.
kits: 卡面上的埃及長矛屬於早王朝時期的兵器：銅或青銅矛頭以綁繩固定在木桿上，主要用於守城垣與列陣，並非 941 年任何一支軍隊的制式裝備。它在這場戰爭裡的位置是象徵性的：它指向拜占庭體系中以矛兵為核心的那一部分兵員——各軍區的徵召民兵，尤其以埃及軍區為代表。埃及軍區是帝國最大的稅收與糧食來源，向其他軍區與首都輸送兵員與小麥，並經黑海船運把糧食運往君士坦丁堡；其中的「埃及人」營團延續著當地以長矛與小盾列陣的古老傳統，也因此常被派往克里米亞與亞美尼亞方向作戰。真正投入 941 年戰鬥的裝備另有兩套。羅斯一方以瓦良格人的裝備為主：直徑約六十厘米的圓木盾包皮革、雙刃斧、短劍與直柄長矛，頭盔多為鐵片或皮質，多數人無甲；船隊用小型平底船與帆，靠木樁、纜繩與人力拉纜通過急流。拜占庭步兵以約兩米長的直柄長矛配小圓盾為主，輔以短劍、胸甲與頭盔；精銳的禁衛軍有全身札甲與鎧甲胸甲，配以弓箭手、弩手與投石手。拜占庭重騎兵穿鎖子或鱗甲、配長矛與長劍，馬匹亦有罩甲；輕騎兵用弓與標槍。海軍備有帆、撞角、投石器與希臘火（配方的機密成分從不外傳），並在博斯普魯斯海峽張設鐵鏈。三十年後，斯維亞托斯拉夫在亞切洛河畔正是被拜占庭親王的長矛刺中胸口，那支矛與卡面所繪的長矛同屬這一類兵器的譜系。
kitsEn: The Egyptian spear on the card belongs to the early dynastic period: a copper or bronze head lashed to a wooden shaft, used above all to defend city walls and to hold a line, and it was not the standard issue of any army in 941. Its place in this war is symbolic. It points to the part of the Byzantine order in which the spear-man stood at the centre, the conscript levies of the themes, and above all the theme of Egypt. The Egyptian theme was the empire's largest source of taxes and grain, supplying men and wheat to the other themes and to the capital and carrying that grain to Constantinople by sea across the Black Sea, and the Egyptian detachments carried on the ancient local tradition of fighting in line with long spears and small shields, which is why they were often used in the Crimea and in Armenia. The equipment actually used in the fighting of 941 falls into two other sets. The Rus' fought with the equipment of the Varangians: round wooden shields faced with hide, bearded axes, short swords and straight spears, helmets of iron plate or leather, and very little armour on most men; their fleet used small flat-bottomed boats with sails and passed the rapids on poles, cables and human muscle. Byzantine infantry fought with straight spears about two metres long and small round shields, supported by short swords, cuirasses and helmets; the elite guard had full mail and plate cuirasses, and the army as a whole included archers, crossbowmen and stone-throwers. Byzantine heavy cavalry wore mail or scale and carried long lances and long swords, with the horses also armoured, while light horse used the bow and the javelin. The navy carried sail, ramming irons, catapults and Greek fire, of whose formula the secret components were never published, and the Bosporus was closed with a chain. Thirty years later Sviatoslav was struck in the chest by the lance of a Byzantine prince on the banks of the Achelous, and that lance belonged to the same family of weapons as the spear on the card.
tactics: 羅斯的戰法有固定的樣式。船隊自基輔沿第聶伯河靠岸人力拉纜行舟，由步兵與弓手在岸上護衛，抵達黑海北岸的碼頭後登船改用帆行；這條「拉舟」水道能避開草原部落與林區游騎的襲擊，卻使整體速度受限，從第聶伯河口到博斯普魯斯要耗去數週。船隊進入黑海後沿西岸北上，掠過克里米亞與保加爾沿岸的希臘殖民地，直抵海峽，目標是襲擊首都郊區的住屋、穀倉與市集，奪取財貨後迅速撤退，而不是強攻城牆——拜占庭的城牆高聳、塔樓密布，並有水門與塔上投射兵器，強攻並無勝算。陸軍騎兵縱隊則採草原式的流動戰：只帶數日口糧，以大縱隊疾進，抵達保加爾境內即以劫掠補給，盡量避免與帝國步兵正面結陣，也因此讓拜占庭無法用一次會戰了結戰事。拜占庭的對應分三路：狄奧斐洛斯自安條克前線趕回首都，整備黑海分艦隊，在金角灣與海峽入口張設鐵鏈、備妥希臘火與投石器；從安納托利亞與色雷斯軍區抽調的民兵在色雷斯與馬其頓集結，以營寨、壕溝與拒馬擋住騎兵衝鋒；再以黃金津貼買通佩切涅格人與馬扎爾人，讓他們襲擊羅斯的土地、村鎮與退路。決定性的轉折不是任何一次會戰，而是黑海的秋季風暴：它摧毀船隊，使進攻全盤瓦解，殘餘的羅斯人在回程中又遭佩切涅格人與匈牙利人截擊，騎兵縱隊遂在歸途上潰散。
tacticsEn: The Rus' followed a fixed pattern. The boats were hauled down the Dnieper from Kyiv by men on the bank, with infantry and archers escorting them, and once they reached the landing places on the north shore of the Black Sea they boarded and sailed. The tow-path route kept the fleet clear of the steppe riders and of the forest raiders, but it also slowed it down, and the passage from the Dnieper mouth to the Bosporus took weeks. Once in the Black Sea the fleet worked up the western shore, passed the Greek settlements of the Crimea and of the Bulgarian coast, and made for the straits with the object of striking the suburbs of the capital, the houses, the granaries and the markets, carrying off booty and running away again, rather than of assaulting the walls. The walls were high and closely flanked by towers, with water gates and missile troops on them, and a direct assault had no prospect of success. The land column of cavalry followed the mobile style of the steppe: it carried only a few days of rations, moved in a wide column, and lived by plunder once it reached Bulgarian territory, deliberately avoiding a set-piece confrontation with the imperial infantry, so that the Byzantines could not settle the war with a single battle. The Byzantine answer ran along three lines. Theophilos came back from the Antioch front to the capital, refitted the Black Sea detachments, laid chains across the Golden Horn and the mouth of the straits, and had Greek fire and catapults ready. Levies drawn from the Anatolic and the Thracesian themes were assembled in Thrace and in Macedonia, with camps, ditches and chevaux-de-frise to break the charge of horse. And gold subsidies were paid to the Pechenegs and Magyars so that they would harry the Rus' lands, their villages and their line of retreat. The turning point was not any battle but a storm on the Black Sea in autumn: it destroyed the fleet, ruined the whole expedition, and the survivors, intercepted on the way back by Pechenegs and Hungarians, saw the cavalry column dissolve on the road home.
data: 可據以寫的數字大致如下。船隊規模見於《斯克里齊斯編年史續編》，記為約五百艘，這是現存最明確的一個數字。編年史把此事記在 6411 年，按教會曆即 941 年 9 月至 942 年 8 月，實際作戰集中在夏末至秋季，具體月份史無明文。騎兵大軍的規模沒有可靠記載，編年史只說人數眾多；後世史家常引用六萬騎兵的說法，但此數出自十八、十九世紀的推估，無法核實，只能確定它是一支足以在草原上縱隊行軍數週的龐大騎兵集團。距離方面，基輔至第聶伯河入海口的拉舟航段約九百公里，基輔至君士坦丁堡的海路約一千六百公里，多瑙河口至首都約七百公里；船隊由河口至海峽約需數週。風暴之後，拜占庭黑海分艦隊多數沉沒，數百名水手與船員溺斃，克里米亞的希臘殖民地因歉收而出現饑荒；羅斯船隊損失更重，僅數百人得救，其餘或溺斃，或於布格河與第聶伯河匯合的三角洲一帶被佩切涅格人殺害。佐證材料包括 945 至 947 年抵達君士坦丁堡的羅斯使者團留下的裝備與風俗描述，以及聖索菲亞大殿迴廊中那幅提及「羅斯人」被制服的鑲嵌畫題記，一般被解釋為 941 年遠征失敗的紀念，另有學者主張應屬 944 年。拜占庭支付給佩切涅格人與馬扎爾人的年度黃金津貼，在這次遠征的記載中沒有留下數目。
dataEn: The figures that can be given are roughly these. The size of the fleet is given in the Continuation of the Chronicle of Skylitzes as about five hundred ships, and that is the most precise figure that survives. The chronicles place the business in the year 6411, which in the church reckoning runs from September 941 to August 942; the fighting itself fell in late summer and autumn, and no source gives a month. There is no reliable figure for the mass of cavalry: the chronicle says only that it was very large, and the often-quoted figure of sixty thousand horsemen comes from eighteenth and nineteenth century conjecture and cannot be checked. All that can be said with certainty is that it was a great body of horse able to march in column for weeks across the steppe. As for distances, the tow-path stretch of the Dnieper from Kyiv to the sea is about nine hundred kilometres, the sea route from Kyiv to Constantinople about one thousand six hundred, and about seven hundred from the mouth of the Danube to the capital; the fleet took some weeks to cover the passage from the river mouth to the straits. After the storm the Byzantine Black Sea squadrons were largely lost and several hundred sailors and oarsmen drowned, while a poor harvest brought famine to the Greek settlements of the Crimea. The Rus' losses were heavier still: only a few hundred were saved, and the rest either drowned or were killed by the Pechenegs around the delta where the Bug meets the Dnieper. The supporting evidence includes the account of the Rus' embassy that reached Constantinople in 945 to 947, which describes their equipment and their customs, and the inscription beside the mosaic in the gallery of Hagia Sophia in Constantinople that speaks of the Rus' being defeated. It is generally read as a commemoration of the failure of 941, though some scholars argue for 944. No sum is recorded in the sources for this expedition for the annual gold subsidies paid to the Pechenegs and the Magyars.
cause: 羅斯人能夠把這樣一支大軍送到君士坦丁堡城下，是幾十年積累的結果。從九世紀起，瓦良格人與斯拉夫人就沿「從瓦良格人到希臘人之路」經過大湖與黑海，從事劫掠、護商與受雇作戰；拜占庭自九世紀中葉起向羅斯首領支付黃金與絲綢，換取他們不進攻克里米亞與黑海沿岸，這份以羅斯首領族譜為憑的協議，是羅斯對拜占庭最早的正式外交文件之一。羅斯商人與雇傭兵在黑海航線上不斷遭到希臘與保加爾船隻的攔截與掠奪，克里米亞的哥特人聚落與希臘殖民地的財富又近在咫尺，東歐平原上的馬匹與人口足以支撐遠征，因此貿易與劫掠的利益共同推著羅斯人向南看。拜占庭方面的弱點同樣清楚：狄奧斐洛斯自 839 年起在東方與阿拔斯王朝長期消耗，941 年春在奇利乞亞的戰役失利，帝國在西線能動用的兵員有限，而過去對付羅斯的辦法只有付錢買平安，宮廷中因此主張改用武力一勞永逸。此外，瓦良格人雇傭兵受雇於保加爾人並向其徵收貢賦，羅斯公國與保加爾人既合作又爭地，戰爭的導火線正落在這段糾葛上。伊戈爾本人則是把這些條件整合成一次大規模海陸協同遠征的人。
causeEn: The Rus' were able to bring an army of this size beneath the walls of Constantinople because of several decades of accumulated experience. From the ninth century the Varangians and the Slavs had followed the route from the Varangians to the Greeks, through the great lakes and the Black Sea, living on plunder, escorting trade and taking service for hire. From the middle of the ninth century Byzantium had been paying the Rus' chiefs in gold and silk in return for their not raiding the Crimea and the Black Sea coast, and that agreement, recorded on the genealogy of the Rus' chiefs, is one of the earliest formal diplomatic documents of Rus'-Byzantine relations. Rus' merchants and mercenaries were constantly intercepted and plundered on the Black Sea routes by Greek and Bulgarian vessels, and the wealth of the Gothic settlements and the Greek colonies of the Crimea lay close at hand; the horses and the manpower of the eastern plain were sufficient to sustain an expedition. Profit from trade and from plunder therefore turned the Rus' eyes southward. The weakness on the Byzantine side was equally plain: Theophilos had been tied down in the east against the Abbasid caliphate since 839 and had suffered a reverse in Cilicia in the spring of 941, so that only limited forces were free in the west, while the only method used against the Rus' had been to pay for peace, and voices at court argued for settling the matter once and for all by force. In addition, Varangian mercenaries in Rus' service were employed by the Bulgars and levied tribute from them, and the Rus' principality both collaborated with and competed with the Bulgars for the same ground; the spark of the conflict lay precisely in that entanglement. Igor was the man who assembled all these conditions into a single large-scale combined naval and land expedition.
impact: 這次遠征失敗，卻把羅斯第一次帶到拜占庭的地緣政治中心。從此東歐不再是可以在帝國後院隨意放棄的邊地：君士坦丁堡開始在黑海北岸維持常駐的觀察與聯盟網，與克里米亞的哥特人、佩切涅格人、匈牙利人往來，並把克里米亞的希臘殖民地與港口升格為據點。拜占庭對羅斯的政策也從付錢買和平轉為養兵、結盟與報復，最典型的是 954 年拜占庭反過來與羅斯王公斯維亞托斯拉夫結盟攻打哈扎爾，並藉此除掉哈扎爾可汗；這是帝國第一次把羅斯人當作傭兵用來削弱羅斯自己。羅斯內部則付出慘痛代價：伊戈爾遠征失敗後失去對德雷夫利亞人的控制，945 年在該部族的叛亂中被殺，兒子同時遇害；其子斯維亞托斯拉夫繼位後把重心東移，先取哈扎爾與卡緬，再南下匈牙利與保加爾。羅斯與拜占庭的接觸反而更密：945 年之後數批羅斯使者團的記錄留下了同期可核的風俗與武器描述，而三十年後斯維亞托斯拉夫在亞切洛河被拜占庭親王的長矛刺中胸口，倒在河畔，羅斯南進的攻勢就此被擋下，帝國與草原之間的力量天平重新回到君士坦丁堡一側。
impactEn: The expedition failed, but it brought the Rus' for the first time to the geopolitical centre of the Byzantine world. Eastern Europe could no longer be treated as a backyard that might be abandoned at will. Constantinople began to keep permanent observation and a network of alliances on the north shore of the Black Sea, dealing with the Goths of the Crimea, the Pechenegs and the Hungarians, and raised the Greek settlements and harbours of the Crimea to the status of strongpoints. The policy towards the Rus' changed as well, from buying peace with money to raising troops, making alliances and taking revenge. The clearest case is the alliance of 954 between Byzantium and the Rus' prince Sviatoslav against the Khazars, in which the khan was killed; it was the first time the empire used the Rus' as hired swords to weaken the Rus' themselves. The Rus' paid dearly at home. Defeated, Igor lost control of the Drevlians, was killed in their revolt in 945, and his son was killed with him. His successor Sviatoslav shifted his weight eastward, taking the Khazars and Kerch first and then turning south against Hungary and Bulgaria. Contact between the Rus' and Byzantium in fact grew closer: after 945 several Rus' embassies left descriptions of customs and weapons that can be checked against the period, and thirty years later Sviatoslav was struck in the chest by the lance of a Byzantine prince on the banks of the Achelous and fell there, and the southward drive of the Rus' was checked, with the balance of power between the steppe and the empire tipping back to the side of Constantinople.
result: 結果是羅斯第一次大規模南征的徹底失敗。船隊在黑海風暴中全滅，陸上騎兵縱隊在歸途中被佩切涅格人與馬扎爾人截擊，損失大半，能回到基輔的只是零星散卒；拜占庭同樣失去了黑海分艦隊的多數船隻，首都卻未受攻陷，克里米亞的糧荒則是這場風暴留下的實質創傷。伊戈爾回到基輔後與奧列格反目，被迫遷往德雷夫利亞人的地盤，944 年被自己委任的將領驅逐，945 年更被該部族殺死，兒子斯維亞托斯拉夫同時遇害。拜占庭則得到一份沒有料到的收穫：一位能征善戰的北方盟主，一批熟悉黑海航路與草原情況的情報，以及 954 年與羅斯聯手攻擊哈扎爾的機會。長期看，這場敗仗並沒有終止羅斯的南向擴張，反而讓斯維亞托斯拉夫把重心推向東北方：先取哈扎爾、卡緬，再於 965 年攻入保加爾、968 年取塞爾古拉，直到 971 年在亞切洛河被拜占庭的長矛打倒，才把羅斯的帝國方向永久地改寫。對拜占庭而言，941 年的教訓寫進了此後的政策：以最小的代價，把羅斯人留在黑海對岸，等他們自己把力量耗在草原上。
resultEn: The result was the complete failure of the first large-scale southern expedition of the Rus'. The fleet was annihilated in the Black Sea storm, the cavalry column was intercepted on its way home by Pechenegs and Magyars and lost the greater part of its numbers, and only a scattering of stragglers reached Kyiv. Byzantium also lost most of its Black Sea squadron, but the capital was never entered, and the famine in the Crimea was the real wound left by the storm. Back in Kyiv, Igor quarrelled with Oleg, was driven out to the land of the Drevlians, was expelled in 944 by officers he had himself appointed, and was killed by that tribe in 945 together with his son Sviatoslav. Byzantium received an unexpected windfall: a northern ally who was a skilled commander, a stream of intelligence about the Black Sea routes and the steppe, and the chance to strike at the Khazars together with the Rus' in 954. In the long run the defeat did not end Rus' expansion to the south; it pushed Sviatoslav's weight eastward instead, to the Khazars and Kerch, then into Bulgaria in 965 and to Serdica in 968, until the lance of the Byzantines broke him at the Achelous in 971 and the direction of the Rus' state was permanently rewritten. For Byzantium the lesson of 941 was written into policy thereafter: at the least cost, keep the Rus' on the far side of the Black Sea and let them exhaust themselves on the steppe.
